minimum_indesign: 16.0 (IDML DOM version); use a current supported release
invocation: Explicit indesign export/compose commands or the manual workflow only
figure_editing: Linked editable SVG originals in Links; InDesign frames are native. SVG paths/labels are edited in the source, not converted into native InDesign page items.
layout: Editable InDesign composition with native tables, threaded chapter stories, master furniture and anchored art; pagination is recomposed by InDesign and is not the approved Typst PDF pagination.
